entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: ¶Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold [where] they fine [it]. {vein: or, mine}

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass [is] molten [out of] the stone. {earth: or, dust}

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; [even the waters] forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: [As for] the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

words.text: : and under it is turned up

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: The stones of it [are] the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold. {dust...: or, gold ore}

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: [There is] a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots. {rock: or, flint}

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and [the thing that is] hid bringeth he forth to light. {overflowing: Heb. weeping}

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: But where shall wisdom be found? and where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: ¶The depth saith, It [is] not in me: and the sea saith, [It is] not with me.

words.text: , It [is] not in me: and the sea

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed [for] the price thereof. {It...: Heb. Fine gold shall not be given for it}

words.text: thereof. {It...: Heb. Fine gold shall not be given for it}

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it [shall not be for] jewels of fine gold. {jewels...: or, vessels of}

words.text: of it [shall not be for] jewels

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom [is] above rubies. {coral: or, Ramoth}

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

words.text: it, neither shall it be valued

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: ¶Whence then cometh wisdom? and where [is] the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air. {air: or, heaven}

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, [and] seeth under the whole heaven;

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out. {declare...: or, number it}

words.text: it, yea, and searched it out

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that [is] wisdom; and to depart from evil [is] understanding.
